The issue is that the `warnings.warn` calls are missing `stacklevel=2`, which affects how the warning is attributed. But more importantly, looking at the test for `on_event`, the current implementation in the file delegates to `self.router.on_event(event_type)` without issuing its own warning.

The target functions need `stacklevel=2` to properly trigger the deprecation warning when called from the test context.
